title: One Of These Paintings BREATHES 🖼️
description:
Six paintings in one hall, lettered A to F. One of them is breathing.

Find it before the clock chimes and comment the letter.

It's made up. A short creepy blocky puzzle, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment your LETTER if you picked before the chime.
